title: MemoryGrant
description: Capability grant from the space to a principal, optionally narrowed by subject, placement contexts, and expiry. Evaluation and non-amplification rules are §6.5 (MEM-R006, MEM-R017).

subject_id.description: Optional subject narrowing; absence = space-wide grant.

capabilities.description: Open capability vocabulary. Core (documented, not enforced): capture, review, records_read, records_write, recall, profile_write, reflect, promote, transfer, admin. admin implies grant management and all other capabilities within the grant's coverage.

context_ids.description: Optional restriction over placement contexts. Omitted = unrestricted within the grant's subject/space scope (includes shared visibility and subject_all selection). Present = only the listed placement contexts, plus shared visibility iff shared_access is true.

shared_access.description: Default false. Meaningful only when context_ids is present; MUST be omitted when context_ids is omitted. Covers shared-visibility data and shared_only / include_shared selections, still never subject_all.

expires_at.description: Optional; absence = no expiry. Expired grants are treated as revoked.
